Occurrences.Kwic: 萬有全歸掌握。大機大用，草偃風行；全暗全明，超情離見。所以道：神光不昧，萬古徽猷。入此門來，莫存知解；知解既泯，真智現前。八字打開，分明顯示。竪起拂子云：還見麼？於斯見得，言語路絕，取捨情忘，了非生佛未分，豈是威音那畔？權實俱備，照用雙行，流出自己胷襟，要且不從人得。既不從人得，正當今日祝嚴聖壽一句作麼生道？良久云：四海浪平龍睡穩，萬年松在祝融峯。示眾，云：兵隨印轉，三千里外絕煙塵；將逐符行，二六時中淨躶躶。不用鐵旗鐵鼓，自然草偃風行，何須七縱七擒？直得無思不服。所謂大丈夫，秉慧劒，般若鋒兮金剛燄，非但能摧外道心，早曾落却天魔膽。正恁麼時，且道主將是甚麼人？喝一喝。示眾云：南泉道：我十八上便解作活計，囊無繫蟻之絲，厨乏聚繩之糝。趙州道：我十八上便解破家散宅，南頭賣賤，北頭賣貴。撿點將來，好與三十棒，且放過一著。何故？曾為宕子偏憐客，自愛貪盃惜醉人。示眾。提起拄杖，云：敲空作響，罕遇知音。復擊繩床，云：擊木無聲，稀逢鑒者。莫向情中卜度，休於事上情量。縱饒劃斷兩頭，未是到家時節。且道作麼生是到家時節？良久，云：清風已逐和風去，朱夏還隨暑氣回。示眾，云：未開口時先分付，擬思量處隔千山，莫言佛法無多子，未透玄關也大難。只如玄關作麼生透？喝一喝。示

Senses.Explanation: “Bodhi originally has no tree” is Huineng’s first verse line, preserved as a quoted case-line and repeatedly appraised in later encounters. Two transmissions explicitly assign the line to Huineng and preserve it with the mirror, nothing-at-all, and dust lines. Daguan Tanying raises both Shenxiu’s and Huineng’s verses, then refuses to treat either as a final possession; Yulin Tongxiu reuses Huineng’s line as an answer to “the phrase without.” The entry therefore preserves an attributed, repeatable case-line. It does not turn the line into a free-standing definition of bodhi or decide the patriarchs’ appraisals.

The bodhisattva precepts are a named class of precepts that the records describe as received, conferred, and kept. Zhuanyu Guanheng says that one who keeps them enters the bodhisattva rank. Yongming Yanshou distinguishes this precept class while defining it through contemplation of mind rather than an external object. Shanhui Huan's biography records that receiving these precepts led him to compare their demands with the monastic precepts he had already received. Yushan Shangsi's record marks their formal completion, while Weilin Daopei raises his late teacher Yongjue Yuanxian's direct question asking what the bodhisattva precepts are. These uses retain a hard rule and formal reception or conferral, even where masters state their basis in mind.
Senses.Note: The disciple-title, reception event, rule-body, and direct-question uses name the same institutional precept class; grammatical differences do not require separate senses.
